svg.title: 100-application milestone: 140 confirmed submissions
svg.desc: Submission checkpoint on 3 November 2026: 140 confirmed, seven uncertain attempts and one user-reported application excluded. Separate historical response review on 29 October: three interview invitations and one assessment request. No current full inbox review or offer count. Host-assisted, not a speed benchmark.

g.text: 7 uncertain + 1 user-reported excluded; immediate delivery failures excluded.
These belong to the older 120-submission snapshot, not a current breakdown.
No new full inbox review or current offer count. Invitations do not prove attendance.
Private evidence retained. Submission is not delivery, an interview or an offer.
